verdicts.reason: A has a clean headline-to-CTA hierarchy and the CTA has room around it, but the Lumen & Fig logo has shrunk to an illegible speck in the bottom-left, the 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow falls below the body copy (wrong reading order), and the bottle crowds the card edge. B jams the 'Shop the Serum' button right up against the end of the headline so they nearly collide, and the eyebrow is tiny, low-contrast text pushed into a footer beside the logo. B's logo stays readable, but the headline/CTA crowding is the worse flaw.
